ex.s: Mr Dena kept an unforgettable ___41___ by Sir Isaac Newton on his chalk board: “If I have been able to see further, it is only because I stand on the shoulders of giants.” He reflected on that throughout the year and was ___42___ to teach us more than math.

ex.s: Each pair of students meets three times throughout the term with a teacher who decides if the exchange is effective.

ex.s: All participants must address how communication or transportation technology has promoted the quality of life for Americans throughout history． To many people，technology means computers， hand﹣held devices， or vehicles that travel to distant planets． However， technology is also the application of scientific knowledge to solve a problem， touching lives in countless ways．
ex.t: 所有参与者都必须阐述通信或交通技术如何在整个历史中提升了美国人的生活品质。对许多人来说，技术意味着计算机、手持设备或驶向遥远行星的交通工具。然而，技术也是应用科学知识解决问题，以无数方式触动生活。

ex.s: Mathematical models have also revealed that food webs may be unstable， where small changes of top predators can lead to big effects throughout entire ecosystems． In the 1960s， scientists proposed that predators at the top of a food web had a surprising amount of control over the size of populations of other species﹣including species they did not directly attack．
ex.t: 数学模型也揭示，食物网可能不稳定，顶级捕食者的微小变化会在整个生态系统引发巨大效应。20世纪60年代，科学家提出，食物网顶端的捕食者对包括它们不直接攻击的物种在内的其他物种种群规模有着惊人的控制力。

ex.s: Stephanie Dutkiewicz，a scientist in MIT's Center for Global Change Science，built a climate model that projects changes to the oceans throughout the century.
ex.t: 麻省理工学院全球变化科学中心的科学家斯蒂芬妮·杜特凯维奇建立了一个气候模型，预测本世纪海洋的变化。

ex.s: To figure out how much power these devices are using, Callie Babbitt and her colleagues at the Rochester Institute of Technology in New York tracked the environmental costs for each product throughout its life — from when its minerals are mined to when we stop using the device.
ex.t: 为弄清这些设备耗电多少，纽约罗切斯特理工学院的卡莉·巴比特和同事追踪了每件产品从矿物开采到停用全生命周期的环境成本。

ex.s: Using shells for money was common throughout the Pacific islands as late as the early 1900s, but Malaita is unique in that they are still used today.
ex.t: 使用贝壳作货币在整个太平洋岛屿一直普遍到20世纪初，但马莱塔的独特之处在于它们至今仍在使用。

ex.s: With these main reasons in mind, we can evaluate our level of anger throughout the day and prevent cases of outbursts by comprehending the reasons for our feelings.
ex.t: 牢记这些主要原因，我们就能评估自己一整天的愤怒程度，并通过理解情绪缘由，防止爆发。

ex.s: "Throughout my entire life, I've had my brother trying to beat me at everything I do.
ex.t: “在我整个一生中，我都有个兄弟试图在我做的每件事上击败我。”

ex.s: His works are known throughout the world, though few details are known about his life.

ex.s: There have been golden ages of invention throughout history.
ex.t: 历史上一直有发明的黄金时代.

ex.t: 一辈子,他做了90多个自画像!

defs.def: during the whole period of time of sth 自始至终；贯穿整个时期

ex.s: Throughout our Junior year, my classmates and I have been worried about what colleges will see when they look at our whole life story reduced to a single 200-word essay.
ex.t: 整个高三年级，我和同学一直担心：当大学把我们整个生平浓缩成一篇200词的短文来看时，他们会看到什么。

ex.s: Throughout the colonial period, tobacco was used in lieu of coins or paper bills in Virginia, Maryland and North Carolina, even though it was used elsewhere in the colonies and extensively throughout Europe and the UK
ex.t: 在整个殖民时期，烟草在弗吉尼亚、马里兰和北卡罗来纳被当作硬币或纸币的替代物使用，尽管它在其他殖民地以及整个欧洲和英国也被广泛采用。
